evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API changes. The modified files are a GitHub Actions cron workflow, internal Python tooling (tools/version.py), internal tests, and developer-facing documentation (docs/dev/release.md). No user-facing API, CLI contract, or persistence format is affected.
evidence.documentation: docs/dev/release.md was updated in the same PR to reflect the new "cutoff time" language and the 16:00 UTC schedule. All mentions of "Wednesday 19:00 UTC" were replaced with references to "the cutoff time" (pointing to the single source of truth). The update is consistent with the code changes.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Not applicable. The change only touches internal release-branch-cut logic, a cron schedule, and documentation. It does not introduce new CLI commands, GUI behavior, or user-facing features that need release-critical manual verification.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR contains a single commit (sha 1678835f) authored at 2026-09-16T13:27:20Z, which predates the approval at 14:00:42Z. No commits were added after approval.
evidence.review: One approval from @superm1 (submitted 2026-09-16T14:00:42Z). @superm1 covers linux packaging, security, Docker, and containers—closely aligned with CI/release infrastructure. The PR body clearly explains the DRY goal, the time shift to 16:00 UTC, and the new consistency test. No inline comments or requested changes were filed; the diff is self-contained and easy to follow.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change is a pure refactoring: replacing repeated literal hour/weekday values with module-level constants, shifting one cron time, updating docs, and adding a consistency test. No supply-chain dependencies, credential handling, network calls, or code execution paths are introduced.
evidence.tests: Existing test times in test/test_version.py were updated from 19:00 UTC to 16:00 UTC to match the new cutoff. A new CutoffTests class adds test_workflow_cron_matches_the_cutoff, which parses the cron expression from the workflow YAML and asserts it agrees with CUTOFF_HOUR and CUTOFF_WEEKDAY. No existing tests were weakened, deleted, or skipped.

subject: Define the release cutoff once in tools/version.py and move it to 16:00 UTC (#3600)
summary: Consolidates the weekly release cutoff into single constants (CUTOFF_WEEKDAY, CUTOFF_HOUR) in tools/version.py, changes the cutoff from 19:00 to 16:00 UTC Wednesday, and adds a test verifying the cron schedule matches the Python constants.
verdict_reason: A focused, low-risk refactor that eliminates duplicated cutoff-time constants across four files, updates documentation in lockstep, and adds a regression test—reviewed, tested, and all CI checks passed with no post-approval commits.
